text.text: Active while wearing at least one wizard armor piece with this trait.

-10% magic damage per piece (chained across pieces: about -19% with two, -34.4% with four); +2 max health per piece (+8 with four); all buffs and debuffs on you last half as long (this does not stack - x0.5 no matter how many pieces, and infinite durations are unaffected).

Magic only: vanilla magic (potion damage, evoker fangs, warden sonic boom), Iron's Spells nine schools and Goety spells. Physical, void, piercing and true damage, vanilla fire and lava, lightning, wither, poison, dragon breath, drowning, freezing and starvation all hit for full damage.

effects: Magic only, everything else is untouched
